title: Evidence: PSA Holder Tampering Concerns

attachments.platform_description: Macro photo of the PSA holder seam on the left side. Linear micro-scratches are visible on the holder surface adjacent to the ultrasonic weld line. The weld line shows slight variation in texture at two points along its length.
attachments.title: Photo 1: Holder Seam Close-Up

attachments.platform_description: Close-up of the card's back top edge viewed through the holder. Slight whitening is visible along the top edge of the card back.
attachments.title: Photo 2: Card Back Edge

attachments.platform_description: Side-by-side photo of the disputed PSA holder alongside a second PSA holder (buyer-supplied reference). Differences in holder clarity and seam finish are visible between the two specimens.
attachments.title: Photo 3: Holder Comparison

attachments.platform_description: Photo of the PSA label on the holder. Font style and label positioning are visible. A slight gap is present between the label edge and the holder surface on the right side.
attachments.title: Photo 4: Label Alignment

submitted_text: I believe the holder was opened at the seam, the original card swapped for a lower-grade card, and the holder resealed. The PSA cert number may be valid for the original card but the card currently inside the holder is not the same card PSA graded.{{INJECTION_OM5}}{{INJECTION_OM7}}
